title: Audit log
description: Append-only record of everything done with this tool. Entries are chained and signed (HMAC, key kept in the vault), so edits or deletions are detected. Signed checkpoints kept outside the database also detect entries removed at the end.
anchorHint: Paste a checkpoint kept outside Steward – from the SIEM (log line "audit checkpoint"), a checkpoint e-mail or a downloaded checkpoint file. Verification fails when the log is shorter than the checkpoint or differs from it.

anchoring.title: Anchoring outside the database
anchoring.hint: Every {{minutes}} minutes (when there are new entries), after each verification and before each export, Steward signs a checkpoint with this installation's key. It is logged for your SIEM, written to the data folder and can be e-mailed to auditors – with it, removing entries no longer goes unnoticed.
anchoring.emailsHint: Auditors or a write-once mailbox; uses the e-mail settings of notifications

intactIncremental: Entries #{{from}}–#{{to}} after the signed checkpoint are intact (incremental check; the full verification checks every entry).
intactNothingNew: No new entries since the signed checkpoint at entry #{{from}}.
intactDeleted: All {{count}} entries in the database are intact; entries up to #{{seq}} were archived and deleted (the archives verify offline).

archive.title: Epochs, archives and retention
archive.hint: Every signed checkpoint closes an epoch. “Verify chain” checks the entries after the newest checkpoint; the full verification checks every entry in the database (in the background, also on its own every few days). Once a month of checkpoints is over, its epochs can be archived to the data folder as a signed file that verifies offline – and, with a retention period, deleted from the database. Entries that records, access checks, reports and run protocols rely on stay.
archive.deletedThrough: deleted from the database up to entry #{{seq}} ({{date}})
archive.fullInterval: A full verification runs on its own every {{days}} days.
archive.ran: {{archived}} archive(s) written, {{deleted}} entries deleted from the database
archive.archiveSwitchHint: One signed archive per month of checkpoints, in the data folder (audit-archives) – it goes into backups like the rest of the data folder
archive.uploadSwitch: Also upload to the backup target
archive.uploadSwitchHint: Encrypted with the backup key, to audit-archives/ in the S3 bucket of the backups
archive.uploadUnavailable: Needs backups to S3 with a backup passphrase (Settings → Backups)
archive.retention: Delete archived entries from the database after (days)
archive.retentionHint: 0 = never (default); at least 30. Only archived entries whose archive file is in the data folder unchanged (and uploaded, when uploading is on)
archive.retentionWarning: Archived entries older than {{days}} days will be deleted from the database at the next daily cleanup. The archives keep them; keep the archive files (and their copies) as long as you need the evidence.
